newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Robotics launches 56-K PC card modems.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Robotics launches 56-K PC card modems.

text.p: U.S. Robotics on Tuesday introduced its x2-upgradeable Megahertz- and Sportster-brand PC Cards for notebook computers and handheld computing devices.
The 33.6 Kbps modems give users the ability to upgrade in to x2 technology, which allows users to download information from the Internet and other networks at speeds up to 56 kilobits per second.
Estimated prices on the modems range from $229 to $239 each, U.S. Robotics said.
U.S. Robotics said the upgrades for the PC cards will be available in the second quarter of this year, and will likely cost about $50 to $60.
